title: 12 Import and Assets
subtitle: Getting photos, footage, sound, Figma files and a brand into a project — Alligators brand and Studio site
brief: …co tě ještě napadne — Import & Assets: drag photos in, the asset library (247 assets, footage, music), import from Figma, import a brand (logo → palette), light photo editing (background removal), AI-generated images, broken or missing assets. Drawn as edge cases on Alligators brand (Czech content) and Studio site.

sections.title: Getting things in
sections.subtitle: Drag photos from Finder onto an artboard — then paste, a video file, a logo; everything also lands in Assets

sections.title: Assets — 247 things, the third tab of the left panel
sections.subtitle: Grouped by kind, pictures first; drag or press ↵ to place; widen it to browse; search names and tags — and, once you say yes, what's in the pictures

sections.title: Photo editing — light, per use, and nothing lost
sections.subtitle: Select a photo: placement, a look in words, light and colour, remove the background with AI — on this one use; Apply to every use is a choice

sections.title: Generate an image (or a clip)
sections.subtitle: From the AI chat panel or Assets › Generate — the artboard sets the shape, the best of four lands in the frame, ← → tries the others right there

sections.title: Import from Figma
sections.subtitle: Menu › File › Import from Figma… — paste a link, connect once, pick frames and where they go; frames arrive as Figma's exact picture; a FigJam board becomes the whiteboard

sections.title: Import a brand
sections.subtitle: Menu › File › Import a brand… — drop a logo or type a website; it reads, says what failed, then shows colours with their roles, fonts and a preview

sections.title: When a file is waiting, missing, huge, twice, foreign, offline or someone else's
sections.subtitle: Waiting for Jonas's Mac is quiet; Missing + Relink only when no device has it · a 4K file · a .psd · no internet · Tereza's photo · a Figma file you can't open · no Google key

sections.title: Advanced — file names, sidecars, the command
sections.subtitle: One disclosure away in an asset's details: the fingerprint name, the original path, the per-use edits as a sidecar file, the maude command

artboards.label: 1 · Drag 6 photos from Finder onto an artboard
artboards.note: Drop on an artboard and the photos go inside it: the artboard lights up and says what will happen; empty frames fill in order.

artboards.label: 2 · Placed 6 photos — still going up to the cloud
artboards.note: Placed and selected at once; also first in Assets › Just added. Thin bars and Syncing… say what is still uploading.

artboards.label: 3 · Paste, a video file, a logo
artboards.note: ⌘V lands under the pointer; .mov files prepare in place; a logo is cleaned for the canvas, quietly.

artboards.label: 4 · Assets — drag a photo onto an artboard
artboards.note: Assets is the left panel's third tab (Menu › View › Assets, ⌘K). Hover shows the name and where it's used; drag replaces a photo.

artboards.label: 5 · Place without dragging — select a tile, ↵
artboards.note: Select an artboard, then a tile: ↵ places it; the tile's menu (the one overlay here) says the same with Place, and ⌘I opens the details.

artboards.label: 6 · Photos 120 › — a wide view to browse and pick many
artboards.note: A group heading widens Assets into a browse view: names, sort, size, many-select. ↵ fills Fotky ze zápasu's six frames.

artboards.label: 7 · Search what's in the pictures — asked once per project
artboards.note: Names and tags first; one sheet asks to describe pictures for this project (your Claude account). Without AI connected, names only.

artboards.label: 8 · By name · Not used · where the words come from
artboards.note: “dron” by name and by content; Not used leaves out older versions and today's AI takes; a hit jumps the clip to its moment.

artboards.label: 9 · An asset's details — photo, made by AI, footage, sound
artboards.note: Where it's used, who added it, what AI saw; every card has Place (a clip or a sound goes on a video artboard); Made by AI keeps its prompt and one licence line.

artboards.label: 10 · Select a photo — the photo inspector
artboards.note: Edits stay with this one use; the other canvases keep the original until Apply to every use. Remove background wears the spark.

artboards.label: 11 · Crop · Remove background · Done · Apply to every use
artboards.note: The frame moves, the photo stays whole; the cut-out runs on this Mac; Apply to every use is a sheet naming each canvas.

artboards.label: 12 · Generate an image — the ask
artboards.note: The artboard sets the shape (4:5); one line for time and whose key pays, one for the licence.

artboards.label: 13 · Four takes — the best one in the frame, ← → for the others
artboards.note: The best take lands in Gameweek 5, selected; ← → tries the others on the canvas. The picture carries Made by AI, not the artboard.

artboards.label: 14 · Paste a link · Connect once · Pick frames and where they go
artboards.note: Link, a one-time token, frames and a destination (a taken name becomes “(Figma)”). Frames come in as pictures; editing needs Dev Mode.

artboards.label: 15 · Artboards arrive — exact pictures, editable on request
artboards.note: Each frame is Figma's exact picture; Make editable needs the Figma app in Dev Mode on a paid seat. The summary names every compromise.

artboards.label: 16 · A FigJam board becomes the whiteboard
artboards.note: Stickies, sections and connectors stay themselves; a widget that can't come across is named. Ask AI stays in its corner.

artboards.label: 17 · Drop a logo or type a website · Reading · Couldn't read the site
artboards.note: One sheet from drop to result; a site that doesn't answer keeps the logo's colours, with Try again as the one action.

artboards.label: 18 · Import a brand — use it as the project's style
artboards.note: Each colour shows its role (Coral → Accent) and can change; one font found, the logo's lettering not — said plainly.

artboards.label: 19 · Not here yet — Waiting for Jonas's Mac
artboards.note: Quiet, not an error: the frame keeps its place and fills in by itself; Relink… only if you have a copy.

artboards.label: 20 · Missing — no device has it
artboards.note: Removed before it synced, so nobody has it: red hatch, Missing, Relink… as the fix.

artboards.label: 21 · Huge · twice · .psd · offline · Tereza's · a link · Figma access · no Google key · HEIC
artboards.note: Nine awkward arrivals, each answered in one line — nothing blocks the canvas.

artboards.label: 22 · Under Advanced — how assets are stored
artboards.note: Fingerprint names for every file, originals too (combine-40yd.mov is assets/7c40e2b1.mov); footage/ keeps only light copies; the original path, per-use edits as sidecar JSON, the import-asset command.
